correctness.rationale: The final claim audits the wrong Adai recurrence. The published Algorithm 2 sets \(\beta_{1,t}=\operatorname{Clip}(1-\beta_0\widehat v_t/\bar v_t,0,1-\epsilon)\), whereas the package uses the reciprocal ratio \(1-\beta_0\bar v_t/\widehat v_t\). This inversion reverses the intended parameterwise inertia dependence. For the package witness with squared-amplitude ratios \((1.6,0.4)\), \(\beta_0=0.1\), the actual source rule gives inertias \((0.84,0.96)\); the alternating-response amplitudes are approximately \((0.173913,0.020408)\) times the global step, so the larger raw-gradient coordinate remains larger rather than being reversed. Thus the advertised source-form Adai amplitude reversal is false.
